pairs.target: hé tú de wūzi bǐ tǎ wéi xiǎng de zhǎi .
pairs.english: The chart-checking room was narrower than Tavi had imagined.
pairs.hanzi: 核图的屋子比塔维想的窄。

pairs.target: sānmiàn qiáng dōu shì jiàzi , chuāngqián zhī róng dé xià yìzhāng chángzhuō .
pairs.english: Shelves lined three walls; only one long table fitted before the window.
pairs.hanzi: 三面墙都是架子，窗前只容得下一张长桌。

pairs.target: nài lěi yǐjīng bǎ zhuōshàng de tújuàn nuó dào yícè , gěi tā liúchū bànzhāng zhǐ de dìfāng .
pairs.english: Nerai had moved the rolled maps to one side, leaving him half a sheet's worth of space.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾已经把桌上的图卷挪到一侧，给他留出半张纸的地方。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi fàngxià shūdài , xiān bǎ xiùkǒu juàn hǎo .
pairs.english: Tavi set down his bag and rolled up his cuffs first.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维放下书袋，先把袖口卷好。

pairs.target: jīntiānxiàwǔ méiyǒu zhírì , tā tèyì tízǎo chīwánfàn , lùshang lián pà wò xīn zuò de zhǐrén yě méi tíngxià láikàn .
pairs.english: He had no duty that afternoon and had deliberately finished lunch early, without even stopping to see Pavo's new paper puppet on the way.
pairs.hanzi: 今天下午没有值日，他特意提早吃完饭，路上连帕沃新做的纸人也没停下来看。

pairs.target: nài lěi dìgěi tā yìdié suǒyǐn kǎ , jiào tā àn tú jiǎo de hào páixù .
pairs.english: Nerai handed him a stack of index cards, asking him to sort by the numbers at the maps' corners.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾递给他一叠索引卡，叫他按图角的号排序。

pairs.target: yùdào bù yízhì de xiān jiá zhǐtiáo , búyào pínggǎnjué tìrén gǎi .
pairs.english: Mark inconsistencies with slips first; don't correct them by feel.
pairs.hanzi: 遇到不一致的先夹纸条，不要凭感觉替人改。

pairs.target: zhèjiàn shì kāitóu hěn róngyì .
pairs.english: At first it was easy.
pairs.hanzi: 这件事开头很容易。

pairs.target: dìsānzhāng yǐhòu , tǎ wéi biàn fāxiàn yígè dìmíng kěyǐ gēnzhe sāngè bùtóng de hào , yǒu de hào hòumiàn hái dài zhe xiǎozì .
pairs.english: After the third card, Tavi found that one place name could have three different numbers, some with small annotations.
pairs.hanzi: 第三张以后，塔维便发现一个地名可以跟着三个不同的号，有的号后面还带着小字。

pairs.target: tā bǎ dì yīluò pái hǎo , zhèngyào dìguòqù , nài lěi què ràng tā zài kàn tú de niánfèn .
pairs.english: He sorted the first stack and was about to hand it over, but Nerai told him to check the map years again.
pairs.hanzi: 他把第一摞排好，正要递过去，奈蕾却让他再看图的年份。

pairs.target: yuánlái tā bǎ tóng yìtiáo pōdào shàng sāncì bùtóng de cèliáng hé dào le yìqǐ .
pairs.english: He had combined three different surveys of the same hillside path.
pairs.hanzi: 原来他把同一条坡道上三次不同的测量合到了一起。

pairs.target: tā zhǐhǎo chóngxīn fēnkāi .
pairs.english: He had to separate them again.
pairs.hanzi: 他只好重新分开。

pairs.target: zhǐbiān yǒuxiē cuì , bùnéng xiàng píngcháng fānshū nàyàng niēzhù jiǎo wǎng shàng xiān .
pairs.english: Some paper edges were brittle; he couldn't lift a corner as he would when turning an ordinary book's pages.
pairs.hanzi: 纸边有些脆，不能像平常翻书那样捏住角往上掀。

pairs.target: tā xué zhe yòng lìng yìzhāng yìngzhǐ tuō zhe , dòngzuò mànxiàlái , zhuōshàng de yìxiǎopiàn yángguāng biàn cóng shǒubèi yí dào le wànshàng .
pairs.english: He learned to support them with another stiff sheet, slowing down as a patch of sunlight crossed from the back of his hand to his wrist.
pairs.hanzi: 他学着用另一张硬纸托着，动作慢下来，桌上的一小片阳光便从手背移到了腕上。

pairs.target: wūwài ǒuěr yǒurén jīngguò , jiǎobùshēng dào le zhèlǐ jiù biànde hěn qīng .
pairs.english: Occasional footsteps outside seemed to grow quiet by this room.
pairs.hanzi: 屋外偶尔有人经过，脚步声到了这里就变得很轻。

pairs.target: nài lěi yíyè yiyè hé jiù jìlù , méiyǒu xiàng shàngkè nàyàng búduàn wèn tā tīngdǒng méiyǒu .
pairs.english: Nerai checked the old records page by page, without constantly asking whether he understood as in a lesson.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾一页一页核旧记录，没有像上课那样不断问他听懂没有。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi qǐchū hái děng zhe , hòulái yě bǎ nàxiē méi dǒng de dìfāng zhútiáo jì dào zìjǐ de zhǐ shàng .
pairs.english: At first Tavi waited for that; later he too wrote his unanswered questions one by one on his own sheet.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维起初还等着，后来也把那些没懂的地方逐条记到自己的纸上。

pairs.target: dì yīluò zuò wán , nài lěi nuókāi zhènzhǐ , ràng tā kàn liǎngzhāng néng jiē zài yìqǐ de tú .
pairs.english: When the first stack was done, Nerai shifted the paperweight and showed him two maps that fitted together.
pairs.hanzi: 第一摞做完，奈蕾挪开镇纸，让他看两张能接在一起的图。

pairs.target: shàngmiàn nà zhāng huà zhe shānjǐ yǔ chéngqiáng , xiàmiàn nà zhāng què cóng shānjiǎo shēnchū xǔduō xìxiàn , yuè guòhé , zài zuānjìn zhǐbiān méi huà wán de dìfāng .
pairs.english: The upper one showed ridges and city walls; on the lower, many fine lines reached from the mountain's foot, crossed the river and vanished beyond the unfinished paper edge.
pairs.hanzi: 上面那张画着山脊与城墙，下面那张却从山脚伸出许多细线，越过河，再钻进纸边没画完的地方。

pairs.target: liǎngzhāng tú de tóngyígè wèizhì , yǒu yízuò tā rènde de chéngmén , kě chúle zhè zuò mén , qíyú jìng hěn nán yìyǎn duì shàng . "
pairs.english: At the same point on both maps stood a gate he recognized; apart from that gate, little matched at a glance.
pairs.hanzi:
两张图的同一个位置，有一座他认得的城门，可除了这座门，其余竟很难一眼对上。
“

pairs.target: xiàmiàn shì jiù gòujiàn de wèizhì , búshì rén zǒu de lù . " nài lěi shuō .
pairs.english: “The lower one marks old components, not walking routes,” Nerai said.
pairs.hanzi: 下面是旧构件的位置，不是人走的路。”奈蕾说。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yòng zhǐjiān yán yìtiáoxiàn zǒu le bàncùn , zài pèngdào hé yǐqián tíngzhù . "
pairs.english: Tavi followed a line half an inch with his fingertip, stopping before the river.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维用指尖沿一条线走了半寸，在碰到河以前停住。“

pairs.target: zhè dǐxià zhēn yǒu dōngxī ? " "
pairs.english: “There's really something underneath here?”
pairs.hanzi:
这底下真有东西？”
“

pairs.target: zhè yíduàn yǒu jìlù . zài wǎngqián , shì zhàojiù tú chāo de , méi chóngxīn chá dào . "
pairs.english: “This stretch is documented. Beyond it we copied the old map; it hasn't been checked again.”
pairs.hanzi: 这一段有记录。再往前，是照旧图抄的，没重新查到。”

pairs.target: tā bǎshǒu shōuhuí lái .
pairs.english: He drew back his hand.
pairs.hanzi: 他把手收回来。

pairs.target: huī ào shàngmiàn yǒu chéng , chéng xiàmiàn yòu yǒu zhèxiē dōngxī .
pairs.english: Above Ash Hollow was the city, and below the city these things.
pairs.hanzi: 灰坳上面有城，城下面又有这些东西。

pairs.target: tā yǐqián zǒng juéde shān shì shíxīn de , zhī zài néng kànjiàn de dìfāng bèi rén záochū jǐtiáo lù .
pairs.english: He had always thought the mountain was solid, with people cutting a few roads only where he could see.
pairs.hanzi: 他以前总觉得山是实心的，只在能看见的地方被人凿出几条路。

pairs.target: xiànzài zhǐ dié zài yìqǐ , lián nàxiē tā cóngxiǎo wàng guàn de gāochù , yě xiàng yǒu le bèimiàn .
pairs.english: Now, with the sheets overlaid, even heights he'd watched since childhood seemed to have another side.
pairs.hanzi: 现在纸叠在一起，连那些他从小望惯的高处，也像有了背面。

pairs.target: nài lěi bǎ yìzhāng báo tú fù shàngqù , ràng tā zìjǐ duì chéngmén .
pairs.english: Nerai laid a thin map over them and had him align the gate himself.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾把一张薄图覆上去，让他自己对城门。

alignment.english: laid a thin map over them

pairs.target: báozhǐ shàng duō le jìnnián de wūzi hé yíchù shuǐchí , yuánxiān yìtiáo zhíxiàn bèi shuǐchí gàizhù .
pairs.english: The thin sheet added recent houses and a pool that covered an old straight line.
pairs.hanzi: 薄纸上多了近年的屋子和一处水池，原先一条直线被水池盖住。

pairs.target: tā chàdiǎn bǎ " gàizhù " dàngchéng " méiyǒu le ", xiǎngqǐ běi gōng fāng , wòbǐ de shǒu tíng le tíng . "
pairs.english: He almost took “covered” to mean “gone,” then remembered the north workshop and paused with his pen.
pairs.hanzi:
他差点把“盖住”当成“没有了”，想起北工坊，握笔的手停了停。
“

pairs.target: suǒyǐ gàifángzi yǐqián yě dé kàn zhèzhǒng tú ? " "
pairs.english: “So you need these maps before building houses too?”
pairs.hanzi:
所以盖房子以前也得看这种图？”
“

pairs.target: dé kàn , hái dédào xiànchǎng quèrèn . tú búhuì zìjǐ cháng chūxīn tiān de tiějià . "
pairs.english: “Yes, and you still need to check the site. Maps don't grow new iron frames by themselves.”
pairs.hanzi: 得看，还得到现场确认。图不会自己长出新添的铁架。”

pairs.target: tā shuōwán biàn qù fān xià yíjuàn .
pairs.english: She moved on to the next roll.
pairs.hanzi: 她说完便去翻下一卷。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi méiyǒu zài wèn , bǎ nà zuò shuǐchí páng de suǒyǐn bǔ shàng , tóu yícì juéde chāo yígè hào yě néng ràng xīnlǐ fāyǎng .
pairs.english: Tavi asked nothing more, adding the index beside the pool; for the first time copying a number made him restless with curiosity.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维没有再问，把那座水池旁的索引补上，头一次觉得抄一个号也能让心里发痒。

pairs.target: tā xiǎng qù kànkàn zhǐ wàimiàn dàodǐ shì shénmeyàng ,
pairs.english: He wanted to see what lay beyond the paper,
pairs.hanzi: 他想去看看纸外面到底是什么样，

pairs.target: yòu zhīdào zìjǐ hái bùnéng cóng zhèxiē xiàn lǐ fēnqīng nǎ yíduàn shì shícè , nǎ yíduàn zhǐshì biérén liúxià de shuōfǎ .
pairs.english: yet knew he still couldn't distinguish surveyed lines from claims others had left behind.
pairs.hanzi: 又知道自己还不能从这些线里分清哪一段是实测，哪一段只是别人留下的说法。

pairs.target: kàojìn zhuō wěi de yíjuàn hěn jiù , yòng huī dài zhā zhe .
pairs.english: Near the table's end lay a very old roll tied with grey tape.
pairs.hanzi: 靠近桌尾的一卷很旧，用灰带扎着。

pairs.target: nài lěi jiěkāi dàizǐ , tú shàng yǒu yìtiáo héngguò huǎnpō de dàolù , bèi kuānkuānde huī xiàn túqù le zhōngduàn , pángbiān xiě zhe bái lì dào .
pairs.english: Nerai untied it. On the map a road crossed a gentle slope, its middle erased by a broad grey line, with White Shingle Track written beside it.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾解开带子，图上有一条横过缓坡的道路，被宽宽的灰线涂去了中段，旁边写着白砾道。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi rènde " tíng xíng " liǎnggè zì .
pairs.english: Tavi recognized the two characters for “closed to traffic.”
pairs.hanzi: 塔维认得“停行”两个字。

pairs.target: tā xiān yǐwéi lù tā le , biàn qù zhǎo luòshí huò duànqiáo de jìhào .
pairs.english: Assuming the road had collapsed, he searched for rockfall or broken-bridge symbols.
pairs.hanzi: 他先以为路塌了，便去找落石或断桥的记号。

pairs.target: méiyǒu . nàtiáo lù liǎngbiān hái huà zhe fángwū , xiǎo dé xiàng sā zài zhǐ shàng de mǐlì , huī xiàn qiàhǎo chuānguò tāmen zhījiān . "
pairs.english: None. Houses still lined the road, small as rice grains scattered on the sheet; the grey line ran between them.
pairs.hanzi:
没有。那条路两边还画着房屋，小得像撒在纸上的米粒，灰线恰好穿过它们之间。
“

pairs.target: zhèlǐ de rén hòulái cóng nǎlǐ zǒu ? " tā wèn .
pairs.english: “Where did the people here go afterwards?” he asked.
pairs.hanzi: 这里的人后来从哪里走？”他问。

pairs.target: nài lěi táitóu kàn le yìyǎn , shēnshǒu qù ná lìng yìběn cèzǐ . " shàngpō ràoguòqù . lù yuǎn xiē . "
pairs.english: Nerai looked up and reached for another book. “Uphill, around it. A longer way.”
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾抬头看了一眼，伸手去拿另一本册子。“上坡绕过去。路远些。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kànzhe nàxiē xiǎowū .
pairs.english: Tavi looked at the little houses.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看着那些小屋。

pairs.target: tú biān de bǐlì tā yǐjīng huì suànle , zhǐjiān liángguòqù , shàngpō zài rào huílái , juébù zhǐshì duō zǒu jǐbù . "
pairs.english: He could now calculate from the scale at the map's edge: tracing uphill and round with his fingertip, it was far more than a few extra steps.
pairs.hanzi:
图边的比例他已经会算了，指尖量过去，上坡再绕回来，绝不只是多走几步。
“

pairs.target: zhè tiáo lù huài le ? " " yǒu wēixiǎn . " "
pairs.english: “Was this road damaged?” “It was dangerous.”
pairs.hanzi:
这条路坏了？”
“有危险。”
“

pairs.target: shì dìshàng huài le , háishì dìxià nàxiē dōngxī ? "
pairs.english: “Damage above ground, or those things underneath?”
pairs.hanzi: 是地上坏了，还是地下那些东西？”

pairs.target: nài lěi ná cèzǐ de shǒu tíng le yíxià , bǎ tā fàngdào zhuōshàng , fānkāi zhéjiǎo nà yè .
pairs.english: Nerai's hand paused over the book, then she set it down and opened a dog-eared page.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾拿册子的手停了一下，把它放到桌上，翻开折角那页。

pairs.target: lǐtou jiá zhe yífèn tíng xíng lìng de chāojiàn .
pairs.english: A copy of a closure order lay inside.
pairs.hanzi: 里头夹着一份停行令的抄件。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yuánběn zhī xiǎng zhǎo rìqī , mùguāng què luò zài zuì xiàmiàn .
pairs.english: Tavi only meant to find the date, but his gaze fell at the bottom.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维原本只想找日期，目光却落在最下面。

pairs.target: tā rènshi nàge míngzì , gāngcái suǒyǐn kǎ shàng háiyǒu tā xīn xiě de zì .
pairs.english: He knew the name; her fresh handwriting was on the index cards beside him.
pairs.hanzi: 他认识那个名字，刚才索引卡上还有她新写的字。

pairs.target: nài lěi .
pairs.english: Nerai.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu bǎ zhǐ chōuzǒu , zhī bǎ pángbiān yāzhù de yìjiǎo zhǎnpíng . "
pairs.english: She didn't pull the paper away, merely flattening a folded corner.
pairs.hanzi:
她没有把纸抽走，只把旁边压住的一角展平。
“

pairs.target: nàcì shì wǒ qiān de . " tā shuō .
pairs.english: “I signed that one,” she said.
pairs.hanzi: 那次是我签的。”她说。

pairs.target: chuāngwài yǒurén hǎn tóngbàn chīfàn , shēngyīn cóng láng nà tóu chuánlái , yuǎn dé xiàng gé zhe yímiàn qiáng .
pairs.english: Outside, someone called a friend to supper from the far end of the corridor, distant as if through a wall.
pairs.hanzi: 窗外有人喊同伴吃饭，声音从廊那头传来，远得像隔着一面墙。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dītóu kàn huī xiàn , yòu kàn tā .
pairs.english: Tavi looked down at the grey line, then at her.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维低头看灰线，又看她。

pairs.target: xiānqián nà gǔ jí zhe wèn xiàqù de jìn hūrán kǎ zài hóulóng lǐ .
pairs.english: His eagerness to keep asking suddenly caught in his throat.
pairs.hanzi: 先前那股急着问下去的劲忽然卡在喉咙里。

pairs.target: tā méixiǎngdào , tú shàng bǎ lù huàdiào de rén , kěyǐ jiù zuòzài zìjǐ pángbiān .
pairs.english: He hadn't imagined the person who crossed out a road on a map could be sitting right beside him.
pairs.hanzi: 他没想到，图上把路划掉的人，可以就坐在自己旁边。
